name: CapitalCampaignTracker
tagline: Run a capital campaign in one Power Apps component – thermometer, gift range chart, pledges and payments, naming and solicitors.
description: A complete capital campaign app: a goal thermometer with the quiet-phase target and public launch, a gift range chart (pyramid) showing gifts and prospects needed per level, a Prospect → Asked → Pledged → Paid in full workflow with multi-year instalment schedules, arrears and write-offs, naming opportunities committed once and at their price, and solicitor workload against capacity. Works in canvas and model-driven apps and on Power Pages.
features: Gift range chart with prospects needed and gaps
Prospect → Asked → Pledged → Paid in full workflow
Naming opportunities with price and single commitment
